info.title: SharpView — source-backed analysis of ASP.NET Core Web APIs (.NET SDK; restored inputs required
info.description: Source-backed analysis of ASP.NET Core Web APIs for people and agents: the MSBuild project reference map with build settings, where exceptions are thrown, caught, miscaught or may escape an action, call paths and reachability from controller actions, and Mermaid diagrams. Uses Roslyn and your installed .NET SDK; never builds or edits the analysed code.

commands.name: diagram
commands.description:
Mermaid call graph of one controller action, saved as Markdown (prompts for an action without --root).
[--root R] [--follow-candidates] [--max-depth N] [--max-nodes N] [--max-edges N] [--budget N] [--output F]

commands.name: exceptions
commands.description:
Every explicit throw with its type, method and location. Or, along call chains from each action:
--uncaught   may escape the action: no catch on the way (one example path per origin)
--caught     reaches a matching catch: where it is thrown and where it is caught
--miscaught  passes through a try whose catch clauses do not match its type
[--uncaught | --caught | --miscaught] [--root R] [--budget N] [--declared-only] [--locations]
Interface/virtual calls are followed into their source implementations (results are marked
as possibilities); --declared-only stops at the declaration instead.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Extraction summary; --methods lists callables and their IDs; --json writes the fact snapshot (schema v3).
[--methods | --json [--output F]]

commands.name: paths
commands.description:
Every call path from each controller action (or from any --root), with project and transitions.
[--root R] [--max-depth N] [--max-paths N] [--budget N] [--locations]

commands.name: projects
commands.description:
Project reference tree with each project's framework, nullable settings and compiler warning count.
[--mermaid [--output F]]

commands.name: reach
commands.description:
What each controller action can reach: every method once, with distance and shortest path.
[--root R] [--follow-candidates] [--max-depth N] [--budget N] [--locations]

options.name: --root
options.description:
One root: an ID (from inspect --methods) or an exact signature. Defaults to every
controller action. reach/paths accept any source method; exceptions/diagram need an action.

options.name: --follow-candidates
options.description: reach/diagram: also follow implementation candidates of interface/virtual calls (marked, never runtime facts).

options.name: --declared-only
options.description: exceptions: do not follow interface/virtual calls into source implementations.

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: reach/paths/diagram: call transitions (default 20), never runtime stack depth.

options.name: --budget
options.description: Examined call sites (default 100000). Raise it when the output says a limit was reached.

options.name: --max-nodes
options.description: diagram nodes, including boundaries (default 200).   --max-edges N  diagram edges (default 1000).

options.name: --locations
options.description: Print call-site evidence for paths and witnesses.

options.name: --mermaid
options.description: projects: also save the tree as a Mermaid diagram in Markdown.

options.name: --output
options.description:
New file for inspect --json, diagram or projects --mermaid; existing files are never overwritten.
Diagrams default to ./diagrams_exports in the current directory.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Default Debug.   --framework TFM  Required for ambiguous multi-target inputs.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Also load test projects (xUnit, NUnit, TUnit, MSTest, SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Pact...); skipped by default.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version; no project load.

options.name: --help
options.description:
This text; no project load.
Exit: 0 complete, 1 usable but with gaps/Unknown/limits, 2 invalid request or fatal, 130 cancelled.

options.name: --uncaught
options.description: may escape the action: no catch on the way (one example path per origin)

options.name: --caught
options.description: reaches a matching catch: where it is thrown and where it is caught

options.description:
passes through a try whose catch clauses do not match its type
[--uncaught | --caught | --miscaught] [--root R] [--budget N] [--declared-only] [--locations]
